artists.biography:
Paul Douglas Webb is an English musician. He was the bassist for English band Talk Talk.
 In the early 2000s he adopted the name "Rustin Man" and collaborated with Beth Gibbons on Out of Season (2002).

perplexity.description:
Drift Code, released on February 1, 2019, is the second studio album by English musician Paul Webb, known as Rustin Man, formerly the bassist for Talk Talk. The album blends elements of rock, folk, world, and country music, showcasing Webb's intricate songwriting and multi-instrumental talents. Its sound is characterized by a rich, textured atmosphere with organic instrumentation including piano, guitars, accordion, and strings, creating a contemplative and immersive listening experience.

This album follows Webb's 2002 debut solo record Out of Season and represents a long-gestating project, with songwriting and recording beginning in 2004 but only completed over a decade later. Drift Code was released on the Domino label and received positive critical reception for its subtle complexity and emotional depth. Commercially, it charted modestly, reaching number 8 on the UK Independent Albums chart and appearing in several European charts, reflecting its niche but appreciative audience. The album is regarded as a mature, atmospheric work that solidifies Rustin Man’s unique place in the intersection of folk and alternative rock.
